background.prompt: Edit target: the supplied autumn daytime landscape background. Create a clean background plate by REMOVE AND REPAINT only the very near foreground flowers, tall grass blades and leafy flower bushes that frame the bottom left and bottom right corners. Replace those near objects with continuous open meadow grass and the natural continuation of the distant trees behind them. The removal area on the left runs from the left edge at about 56% image height downward, across the bottom to about 55% image width; on the right it runs from the right edge at about 67% image height downward, across the bottom to about 71% image width. Remove all oversized pink daisies, white daisies, pink flower spikes, long dark grass blades and near leafy shrubs in these two corner regions. There should be no big foreground plant silhouette anywhere at the bottom. Leave only a softly painted low meadow surface at the bottom, with small distant grass texture following perspective. Do not create bare soil, paths, water, new shadows, or new objects. Preserve the EXACT existing sky, clouds, autumn trees, tree trunks, mountains, horizon, lighting, painting style, camera, framing and original 16:9 aspect ratio. Preserve the central open meadow where the character will stand, and preserve all pixels outside the described two corner regions as closely as possible. No character, no text. This is the background behind separately drawn transparent foreground plants. Output one full landscape plate at the input framing and highest practical resolution.

foreground.initial_prompt: Create one transparent-background foreground plant overlay for the supplied 16:9 autumn meadow illustration. The supplied image is a STYLE AND COMPOSITION REFERENCE, not a background to include. Redraw ONLY the near flowers, grass and low leaves that frame the lower LEFT and lower RIGHT corners, in the same soft painted animation-background style, subdued olive/sage foliage, pale ivory daisies, dusty pink cosmos/daisies and a few pink flower spikes. Keep the composition and scale closely matched to the reference. Full canvas 16:9, ideally 3840x2160. Left cluster: flush with and cropped by the left and bottom canvas edges, tallest grass tips near x=5-18%, y=56-62%, tapering down toward x=45%, y=90%; a small pink daisy can reach x=46%, y=96%; maximum extent x=53% at the bottom. Right cluster: flush with right and bottom edges, tallest leafy tips near x=95-100%, y=68-72%, tapering down to x=73%, y=92%; muted lavender/pink daisies near the lower right. Between the two clusters, keep a completely TRANSPARENT central opening, including the bottom center from x=55% to x=70%, so the meadow continues to the viewer. Everything above and between the plants must be genuinely transparent alpha, including the spaces between stems, leaves and petals. No sky, no trees, no meadow, no mountains, no character, no ground plane or opaque base rectangle, no shadow layer, no vignette, no checkerboard, no labels. Each botanical form should have clean softly antialiased painted edges, not an eroded cutout and not a broad hazy fringe. Moderate painterly detail that matches the reference, not photorealistic, not glossy vector stickers. Keep the lower clusters dense enough to frame the scene while the tips and stems have real transparent openings. This will be a persistent foreground DOM layer in front of a moving character. Output exactly one aligned transparent overlay, not a collage or multiple panels.
foreground.final_prompt: Edit target is Image 1, the transparent foreground plant overlay. Image 2 is the composition and scale reference. Correct ONLY the layout so that the plants are lower, as in Image 2. The first overlay's left grass rises much too high (around y=42%); tallest LEFT tips must instead start at y=55%, and tallest RIGHT tips must instead start at y=67%. Keep full canvas 16:9 and absolutely transparent background. Redraw the clusters with shorter stems and fewer stacked rows of plants, without squashing or stretching the individual flowers. Preserve the soft hand-painted look, flower types, muted foliage colors and the bottom corner framing. Left cluster must still extend along the bottom from x=0 to x=53%, with pale pink flower spikes around x=13%, y=76%, an ivory daisy around x=25%, y=89%, and a dusty pink daisy near x=43%, y=95%. Right cluster must still extend along the bottom from x=72% to x=100%, with the large pale pink daisy around x=94%, y=91%. All the upper 54% of the canvas must be completely transparent. Above the right cluster up to y=66% must be completely transparent. Keep the bottom central opening x=55% to x=70% transparent. Spaces between petals, stems and leaves must be real transparency. Plant interiors must be opaque with delicate antialiased edges; no translucent haze or detached alpha speckles. No sky, meadow, trees, character, backdrop, ground plane, shadow, vignette or checkerboard. Do not make the plants brighter or more saturated. Output a single full-frame aligned transparent layer.
